description.value:
Trigger A creature damages your Ward.

Cost 1 Conviction

Harm done to the Ward is a debt, and you collect it in person, with interest.

You note the debt. Your next Strike that hits the triggering creature before the end of your next turn deals additional damage equal to the damage it dealt to the Ward, to a maximum equal to your level. If that Strike is part of The Answer, the maximum is instead twice your level — the interest. Only one debt can be noted at a time; noting a new one forgives the old.

cinderfall.incomplete: The bonus-damage value is not a fixed formula (@actor.level-style) -- it is 'however much damage a different creature (the Ward) just took,' a runtime value with no roll-option or actor-data path anywhere in pf2e to reference. No rule element can read another actor's just-taken-damage total as an input to the caster's own damage formula.
